notes:
Summary: evaluating Redwood Private VPC deployment for enterprise RAG search across 8-10TB of legal docs (contract corp repositories, discovery sets). Interested in embeddings + reranking pipeline to reduce false positives in e-discovery.

Call notes 2026-02-18 with GC + Head of Legal Ops:
- Customer insists on audit trail for all queries (per user) and immutable retention for 7 years; retention controls and WORM-like policies required.
- Quote from GC: 'We need an auditable chain — who queried what document and when; redaction/meta must survive export.'
- Performance ask: 95th percentile latency <250ms for vector similarity + top-k reranking hybrid (k=50 -> rerank top10) on typical query.
- Scale: 8-10TB index, expecting 200-600 QPS peak for batch review seasons; average ~120 QPS. Cost sensitivity: high for sustained queries; will evaluate cost per query vs in-house Elastic + custom reranker.

Technical constraints:
- No public-hosted data plane allowed. Must run in customer VPC or on-prem with private control plane.
- KMS integration mandatory (customer-run HSM preferred).
- SOC2 + ISO27001 required, plus contractual audit windows.
- Log retention 7 years; audit logs must be exportable to Splunk/Elastic.

POC plan discussed:
- 6-week scoped POC: ingest 500GB canonical corpus, build embeddings (dense + sparse hybrid), validate retrieval latency and rerank precision against labeled prompt set (50 queries).
- Success criteria: p95 end-to-end <350ms on private infra; reranker improves precision@5 by >=18% vs current baseline; operational runbook for incident + rollback; encryption-at-rest and audit log exports validated.
